(B) on each of some 10 days during the calendar year or during the preceding calendar year, each day being in a different calendar week, employed at least 5 individuals in employment in agricultural labor for some portion of the day."
2.  **Section 3306(c)(1)** defines "employment" in agricultural labor terms, referencing the thresholds in 3306(a)(2). Specifically, 3306(c)(1) references the conditions for agricultural labor to be "employment".
    *   3306(c)(1)(A) says agricultural labor is employment unless performed for a person who didn't pay $20k or didn't employ 5 individuals on 10 days in 10 different weeks.
    *   Essentially, to be an "employer" subject to the tax in 3301, one must meet the definition in 3306(a).
    *   3306(a)(2)(B) says: "on each of some 10 days during the calendar year or during the preceding calendar year, each day being in a different calendar week, employed at least 5 individuals in employment in agricultural labor for some portion of the day."
